translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Daro matsoyiyaa ushshaa ushiyaawe daro bidiseenne walassee; matsottiyaa Asay wozanay pac'c'eedda asaa.
Kaatiyaa hank'k'uu gaammuwaa gudetsaa mala; Aa yiloyiyaa Asay bare shemppuwaa bolla pirddee.
Palumiyaappe gas'an de'iyaawe aawoo bonchcho; shin booza Asay ubbay walak'ettanaw elleellee.
Azalla goshshanchchay wodiyaa naagiide goshenna; hewaa diraw, katsaa c'akkiyaa wode I woossee; shin ayaakka demmenna.
Asaa wozanaa halchchuu c'iimmo ollaa giddon de'iyaa haatsaa mala; shin wozanaama Asay hewaa duuk'k'iide kessee.
Daro asatuu barenttu keekkatetsaa odiino; shin tumu ammanettiyaa asaa demmanawe oonee?
S'illo Asay tooshii bayinna de'uwaa de'ee; Aa kaalliide, Aa naanatuukka anjjetteedawantta.
Kaatii pirddanaw bare kawutetsaa araatan utteedda wode, iita ubbaa bare ayifiyaan hark'k'iide kessee.
«Ta wozanaa geeshshaad; taanan nagarikka baawa» yaaganaw danddayiyaa Asay de'aneeshsha?
Med'inaa Goday wordduwaa miizaanan yiggiyaawanttanne likke gidennaban makkiyaawantta is's'ee.
Na'ay geeshshanne suure gidiyaawe I ootsiyaa oosuwaan erettee.
Sisiyaa haytsaanne s'eelliyaa ayifiyaanne, unttuntta laa"uwaakka Med'inaa Goday med'd'eedda.
Gem"ishuwaan ne wodiyaa wurssoppa; neeni hiyyeessana. Beegotta; yaatooppe, neeni katsaa kallana.
Shammiyaa asay, «K'ohee! K'ohee!» yaagee; shin beeddawaappe guyyiyaan, «geluwaan shamaad» yaagiidde c'eek'ettee.
Eray kumeedda haasayay work'k'aappekka ink'k'uwaa giyaa daro al"o shuchchaappekka aad'd'eeda al"obaa.
Erenna asaw waasiyaa geliyaa uraa mayuwaa k'aari akkite; imatsaa asaw waasiyaa geliyaa uraa mayuwaa oyk'k'ite.
Wordduwaan demmeedda katsay asaa mal"ee; shin ak'i kesiidde, doonaa giddon shafiyaadan hanee.
Zoriyaa akkaade ne halchchiyaawaa halchcha; zoriyaa akkenan de'aadde olaw booppa.
Zigiriyaa Asay s'uuraa gentsenna; hewaa diraw, odanchcha uraanna gakkettoppa.
Asay bare aawuwaa woy bare aato shek'k'ooppe, Aa de'uwaa s'omppiyaa d'ip'p'i go d'uman to'ana.
Koyruwan ellekka shiik'eedda ak'uu wurssetsan anjjettenna.
New iitaa ootseedda uraw, «taanikka aw iitaa ootsana» gooppa; Med'inaa Godaan ammanettaade naaga; I neena ashshana.
Med'inaa Goday laa"u k'ommo miizaanatuwaa shenetee; wordduwaa miizaanatuukka Aa nashechchikkino.
Asay baanaw bessiyaa ogiyaa Med'inaa Goday kaaletsee; yaatina, Asay bare de'uwaan baana ogiyaa wootiide akeekanaw danddayii?
Ittibaa elleelliide, «Hawaa taani S'oossaw immaad» gi diggiyaawenne guyyeppe zink'k'ottiyaawe, hewe asaa oyk'k'iyaa p'ire.
Aad'd'eeda eranchcha kaatii makkalanchchatuwaa shaakkiide eree; I unttuntta k'arettennaan muree.
Asaa ayyaanay Med'inaa Godaw s'omppiyaa; hewaa diraw, I nu giddo asatetsaa ubbaa pilggi s'eellee.
Aggena siik'uunne ammanettiyaawe kaatiyaa naagiino; Aa kawutetsaa araatay aggena siik'uwaan minnee.
Yalagatuwaa bonchchuu unttunttu wolk'k'aa; c'imatookka unttunttu puuluntsay unttunttoo bonchchuwaa.
Mino muruu iitatetsaa shoddee; wad'd'iyaawe iita wozanaa laammanaw danddayee.
